main:2.text: Narrated by T-Bug, it consists of four training modules, although only the first two are required to complete the job:

main:3.text: The quest starts out with a montage of V and Jackie's exploits in Night City. Six months later, V find themselves in their car alongside Jackie, discussing the job they're hired to complete by Wakako Okada. V learns that the missing woman is probably in a den of Scavengers, in room 1237 of a certain apartment block. T-Bug helps unlocking the main door and disabling the security system.

main:4.text: Since the last gig, V's cyberware has started to malfunction. After a holocall with Jackie Welles, V decides to pay a visit to their Ripperdoc friend Viktor Vektor at his clinic to find out what the problem might be. V leaves their apartment and heads down to meet Jackie outside Megabuilding H10.

main:5.text: After a brief conversation with Jackie Welles at Misty's Esoterica, he tells V that he's arranged a meeting for them with a local fixer, Dexter DeShawn, about a job. V heads to Dex's limo, which is a short walk from Misty's. During the meeting, which takes place in the limo, V is told about a job to steal an experimental biochip from Arasaka.

main:6.text: After meeting with Dexter DeShawn, V is instructed to obtain the Flathead−a prototype Militech combat bot−from the Maelstromer's led by Royce at the All Foods Factory on Talbot Place in the Northside Industrial District of Watson.

main:7.text: After V spoke with Dexter DeShawn, they were sent to Lizzie's Bar on the corner of Kennedy Avenue and Sutter Street to get in touch with the client, Evelyn Parker. Once inside the bar—between 6:00 PM and 6:00 AM—V approaches the bar and asks the bartender, Mateo Thiago, about Evelyn's whereabouts.

main:8.text: After V retrieved the Flathead from Maelstrom and the information from Evelyn Parker, they are now ready to start the job they were hired to do by Dexter DeShawn. V heads out to The Afterlife to meet up with Jackie. By the entrance, they have a brief chat about Mamá Welles before heading into the club. The bouncer will eventually let them in regardless of the option V chooses.

main:9.text: Following the events of The Heist, wherein V is killed by Dexter DeShawn, the former's brain is repaired by the biochip's nanites, and they begin to relive the memories contained on it, specifically those that occurred on August 20th, 2023. Now in the perspective of Johnny Silverhand, the Rocker makes his way to The Hammer, where Kerry Eurodyne has already begun to perform due to the former being late.

main:10.text: V appears in cyberspace and will sees a red figurem being prompted to follow. They will eventually be able to interact with him, which takes V out of cyberspace. They will wake up in a landfill and crawl out before Dexter DeShawn and Goro Takemura appear. As V slips in and out of consciousness, Takemura ends up killing Dex and puts V in his vehicle to take them to Hanako Arasaka.

main:11.text: After meeting with Takemura, V must track down Evelyn Parker to find out if she knows anything about the Relic. After optionally calling Judy, V heads to Lizzie's Bar, and enters her workshop. After a brief conversation with Judy, V discovers that she doesn't know where Evelyn is, but she points them in the direction of a dollhouse called Clouds on the 12th floor of Megabuilding H8, where Evelyn used to work.

main:12.text: After receiving more information from Oswald Forrest as to Evelyn Parker's location, head to Fingers' clinic on Jig-Jig Street. Before going there, V has the option to let Judy know. She will be waiting for V in front of Fingers' office whether V calls her or not. V must find a way to get inside Fingers' office.[N 1] Once inside, V and Judy will talk to Fingers.

main:14.text: V and Judy save Evelyn Parker from the Scavengers' XBD studio at an abandoned power plant, and Evelyn is taken to Judy's apartment to recover. After speaking with Judy, she heads into the apartment's workspace to continue tweaking the braindances extracted from Evelyn. V can approach and sit beside Evelyn, but she simply lies on the bed without any reply.

main:15.text: Right after completing Double Life, V will need to call Mr. Hands, the fixer for Pacifica, for assistance in getting in touch with the Voodoo Boys. He'll note it'll be almost impossible as they keep to themselves but will check for the merc. Sometime later he'll call with an update: as expected they're not interested in whatever V has but incidentally they have a job that needs to be done and so Mr.

main:16.text: Two of Placide's sentries can be found near the Grand Imperial Mall standing by an old vehicle. Upon speaking to them they will direct V to enter the mall via the garage. There are about three Animals enemies standing directly in the garage entryway and a further five further inside, two of which will leave the complex and the other three are grouped together in the left corner.

main:17.text: After clearing the Grand Imperial Mall and returning to Batty's Hotel, Brigitte leads V to the Maglev Tunnel beneath the Pacifica Serenity Bible Church. This is a hideout of the Voodoo Boys and the physical location of their Data Fortress, Rezo Agwe. Brigitte exploits V and Johnny Silverhand to communicate with Alt Cunningham, who can help the Voodoo Boys' members go through the Blackwall.

main:19.text: Head to the Afterlife and look for Rogue Amendiares, Night City's top fixer and Johnny Silverhand's ex-lover. Asking her about Anders Hellman results in Rogue demanding money in exchange for her help. After paying her and waiting a day, Rogue provides V with an information Shard. V slots it in, learning that the Kang Tao transport is carrying an anonymous person, presumed to be Hellman.

main:20.text: Panam Palmer asks V to meet her again during midnight at the garage near the Sunset Motel in Rocky Ridge, to discuss their plan on how to take down the Kang Tao AV. When V meets her there, she will be working on her truck. She quickly finishes up, and she and V will discuss a plan to use an EMP launched from a power station to take down the Kang Tao AV, and enter the AV to take Anders Hellman.

main:21.text: After taking out the Satwave Power Plant, Panam Palmer and V chase after the crashing Kang Tao AV deep into the Jackson Plains of the southern Badlands. While chasing the AV, communications on the radio frequency have Mitch and Scorpion approach the AV first. Panam attempts to warn Mitch and Scorpion, but the EMP interferes, and she is unable to do so.

main:22.text: After receiving a call from Takemura, head to the Japantown docks. At 11:30 PM Takemura will meet with you after you wait, and Oda will come shortly afterwards. Answer however you like - Oda will refuse to listen but will hint on the issues expected with the upcoming parade.

main:24.text: V must travel through the parade in Japantown, eliminating three snipers who threaten Takemura. A Genjiroh can be found behind a closed door while en route to the second sniper, just after exiting the elevator and before climbing the ladder. The code is 2906. It is also possible to open the door with Technical Ability. The bossfight against Sandayu Oda automatically triggers once V disconnects the netrunner.

main:25.text: After escaping from Arasaka's clutches at the Redwood Market in Japantown, V is contacted by Goro Takemura. He informs V that he has brought Hanako Arasaka to his safe house on Vine Street in Vista del Rey, Heywood, and tells them to knock four times on the door to safely get inside.[N 1][N 2] Having arrived at the safe house, V heads to apartment 303 on the third floor and knocks on the door four times.

main:26.text: This overarching main job is automatically triggered at several key scenes during Act 2, then disappearing from the journal until it is triggered again. A stage triggers right after finishing Automatic Love, Life During Wartime, Search and Destroy, and Transmission. Depending on which quest one decides to finish first, the dialogues will happen at different places, with the exception of the final stage.

main:27.text: After having exhausted all other options, V has no choice but to meet with Hanako Arasaka at Embers.[N 1] After having been cleared by security and taking the elevator to the 13th floor, V meets with Hanako in person. As V approaches Hanako, she stands up from behind the piano and tells V that she knows the location of Mikoshi, beneath Arasaka Tower.

side:1.text: After organizing a meeting with the Voodoo Boys, V is contacted by Judy Álvarez, who asks them to come over as soon as possible.[N 1] As V arrives at the apartment building on Charter street in Northside, Watson, they enter her apartment and get immediately called over to the bathroom by Judy. Inside the bathroom, V is encountered with a gruesome scene.

side:2.text: A few days after helping Judy Álvarez out after Evelyn Parker's suicide, V is contacted by Judy again, and tells them that she has come up with a plan to take revenge on what happened to Evelyn. She tells V that Lizzie's Bar used to be a joyhouse before the Mox took over control, and she plans to do the same with the Tyger Claws owned Clouds in Megabuilding H8.

side:3.text: About a day after Judy Álvarez and V met with Maiko Maeda at Clouds, Judy will text V that she is still working on a plan and that it will probably take a couple more days to finalize the details.

side:4.text: Some time after receiving Judy Álvarez's message thanking them for being a good friend and agreeing to help her free Clouds, V receives a phone call from Judy, telling them that she finally heard back from Maiko Maeda, and that she is gathering with the others–Tom Caldera and Roxanne Sumner–at Megabuilding H8.

side:5.text: To unlock this side quest, do not side with Maiko or don't take her money in Pisces: Some time after the events at Clouds, Judy calls V to meet her at an abandoned shack near Laguna Bend Reservoir at sunrise. Once V arrives, Judy explains what she wants to do here. She tells V that she wants to go diving in the lake where the shack is located, and record a braindance of them doing so.

side:6.text: Some time after nabbing Anders Hellman from Kang Tao, a distressed Panam Palmer calls V with a request to come meet with her at the Aldecaldo Camp in Rocky Ridge. Upon asking her what happened, she tells V that Saul Bright was taken by a group of Wraiths while he and some others were out on patrol, and that they've been observing their camp in Sierra Sonora ever since.

side:7.page: With a Little Help from My Friends
side:7.text: Some time after helping Panam Palmer rescue the Aldecaldos's leader, Saul Bright, she contacts V again, this time to ask if they are able to come to the Mobile Camp in Rocky Ridge as soon as possible.[N 1][N 2] After V arrives at the Mobile Camp, they meet with Panam, Mitch, and Saul in the communications trailer.

side:8.text: A day after helping Panam Palmer and the veteran Aldecaldos seize the Basilisk from Militech, V is contacted by Panam, telling them that they have completed the assembly of the panzer vehicle, and ask V if they want to drive it. After accepting Panam's invite, V heads back to the Mobile Camp in Rocky Ridge to meet with her and the other Aldecaldos.

side:9.text: Some time after the Samurai reunion, Kerry will call V with a request to meet him in the early morning at the Foodscape bar on the corner of Manzanita and Mallagra street in Rancho Coronado, Santo Domingo. If the in-game time is not between 12:30 and 3:30 AM: Kerry arrives in a Galena that he borrowed, and asks V to get in.

side:10.text: Some time after blowing up the Us Cracks equipment van, Kerry Eurodyne will contact V, telling them that blowing up the Us Cracks equipment van didn't work, and that their concert is still going to happen. Kerry wants to meet at Riot, a club in Little China, Watson. Kerry and V walk away from the stall and investigate the exterior of the club to find possible ways to enter.

side:13.text: About 24 in-game hours after completing Off the Leash, Kerry Eurodyne will call V to meet up at the Gold Beach Marina in Downtown, City Center at 7 PM. If V arrives early, they can wait at the dock to pass time. Kerry will be on the deck of one of the yachts moored nearby, calling V aboard.

side:14.text: Some time after completing I Fought the Law, River will call V, needing assistance and requests them to meet him in person to discuss the details. After you get to the designated location and wait for him to arrive, he'll pull up in his truck. Get in and talk to him a bit but he's not really in a chatty mood and will instead send you a video clip to watch of a news reel.

side:15.text: River will invite V for dinner at Joss'. Upon arriving in the evening, one will find River preparing jambalaya outside, and the two can talk about Randy. V can ask about the revenge on Peter Pan, River avoids the subject and instead tells them to get the rice. While doing so, V will run into Joss, with whom the player can converse with further.

side:16.text: A re-released vinyl record of Samurai's Chippin' In.

side:18.text: The quest can be given by Johnny Silverhand after Chippin' In if specific dialogue choices were made. Choosing "A hard road, but looks like we made it." followed by "Johnny, no need to bare your soul to me.", or the Secret Ending dialogue options will start this quest. Other options will lead to Holdin' On.

side:19.text: If Johnny went on a date with Rogue during Blistering Love: If V did not give Johnny a second chance during Chippin' In: Johnny says that he wants V to go to Kerry Eurodyne's villa so that he can talk to his old friend, since he heard news that he is depressed and attempted suicide.

side:20.text: After having recuperated from their injuries in their apartment, V is contacted by Jackie's mother, Guadalupe Alejandra Welles, with the request that V calls her. If V sent Jackie Welles's body to his family, or asked Delamain to wait for V:

side:21.text: At some point after Life During Wartime, V will receive a call from an Elizabeth Peralez, wife of mayoral candidate Jefferson Peralez. She doesn't wish to discuss anything over the holo and requests to meet in person.

side:22.text: Some time after investigating Lucius Rhyne's murder, V will receive a call from Jefferson Peralez requesting that he investigates another case for him and his wife. At the Peralez apartment in Charter Hill, Westbrook, Elizabeth will guide V to the living room. There, the waiting Jefferson explains that he witnessed an intruder in their apartment several nights ago.

side:23.text: Some time after capturing Anders Hellman, V is contacted by Wakako Okada. Wakako offered V a job from one of her more demanding clients, Bill Jablonsky. Jablonsky wants to exact revenge for the murder of his wife, Caroline Jablonsky. The client wants everything to go exactly as planned, and is willing to pay V handsomely in return.

side:24.page: There Is A Light That Never Goes Out
side:24.text: After getting in the NCPD SUV, Vasquez will drive Joshua Stephenson, Rachel Casich and V to their destination. While riding along, Joshua tells V that he was sentenced to prison twelve years ago for armed robbery amongst other things. He continues that he shot and killed several people in cold blood, but that it didn't do anything to him on the emotional level at the time.

side:25.page: They Won't Go When I Go
side:25.text: Some time after leaving the PieZ restaurant after talking with Joshua Stephenson and Rachel Casich, Rachel will call V to say that Joshua has requested their presence while he prepares for his crucifixion braindance. V approaches Joshua, and sits down on the stool in front of him.

side:26.text: Sometime after completing Double Life, Afterlife bartender Claire Russell reaches out to V, offering them a job. She tells them that she needs help with some street races, and is looking for a driver, and since V is a reliable mercenary, she approached them.

side:27.text: After recovering in their apartment from the aftermath of Konpeki Plaza heist, V receives a message that their car—the Archer Hella EC-D i360—was returned to the Megabuilding H10's parking lot.[N 1] Upon entering the car, it is immediately rammed by a divergent cab from the Delamain Corp, wrecking V's car.[N 2] This incident causes Johnny Silverhand to appear before V, and they have an exchange of words.[N 3] Upon…

side:28.text: After receiving compensation for their wrecked car, Delamain asks V if they have time to talk in the back, and ask that they follow the Bombus drone into the factory.[N 1] As V follows the drone, it will tell them that they are aware that customer services is at an unsatisfactory level at the moment, and that they want to give V a full factory tour as additional compensation.

side:29.text: If 48 hours have passed after completing Epistrophy: Upon arriving at Delamain Headquarters, V finds Delamain having difficulties communicating. He tries to open the doors toward the offices and garages but fails to do so.

side:30.text: After the initial fight with the training robot, Punchin' Bag, it functions as a tracker for the following minor jobs: The championship fight against Razor Hugh is held in the Grand Imperial Mall in Pacifica. The fight starts at 12:01 AM, and if V arrives before that time, they'll be prompted to skip the time on a nearby bench.

side:31.text: Some time after dealing with the Voodoo Boys, V will receive a message on their personal computer in their apartment regarding the Bartmoss Collective. After heading up to their apartment and checking out Nancy's post on the Bartmoss website, V give Bess a call.[N 1] After contacting Nancy on the holo, V is directed towards the source of a signal coming from an apartment building on an unnamed street in Rancho…

side:32.text: This job mainly acts as a tracker for the 17 cyberpsycho jobs. Once all of them have been completed, Regina will call V to have a meeting in person, with her comments based on if you had managed to keep them all alive or not before she gives you your reward. If none are killed, she is very grateful, as she is helping them get therapy to further understand their condition.

boss:1.text: Founded in Manchester, England UK, in 1906, Rolls-Royce is a British automotive manufacturer specializing in luxury vehicles and aircraft engines. Some time in the late 1990s BMW acquired the rights to manufacture Rolls-Royce cars. In the 2020s Rolls-Royce manufactures the Pegasus Turbofan engines for aerodyne models like the AV-4, AV-6 and AV-7.

boss:2.text: Matilda has been the alpha animal of her pack since 2075. Her expertise includes heavy melee combat and her weapon of choice was an oversized unique sledgehammer by the name of Sasquatch's Hammer, created specifically for her. In 2077, Matilda was known well enough throughout Night City to attract contractors as big as NetWatch.

boss:3.text: Sandayu Oda (Japanese: 小田 三太夫, Hepburn: Oda Sandayu) is a solo and cyberninja employed by the Arasaka Corporation, assigned as the personal bodyguard of Hanako Arasaka. He specializes in martial arts and utilizes Arasaka Mantis Blades in combat. Upon being admitted to the Arasaka ranks, Oda had been trained by Goro Takemura as a highly skilled fighter.

boss:4.text: Adam Smasher is a full borg mercenary employed by Arasaka who became a notorious solo and rival of Morgan Blackhand. By 2077, he had risen to the position of head of security within Arasaka and the personal bodyguard of Yorinobu Arasaka. Smasher is a towering cyborg, with little humanity left to be seen, not that he ever had much.
